description: Reified 'Dimension' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Dimension Value.description: This field is used to record the value for the documented instance of dimension .

Highest Possible Dimension Value.description: This field is used to record the highest possible value for a dimension when the value of the dimension is known as a range.

Lowest Possible Dimension Value.description: This field is used to record the lowest possible value for a dimension when the value of the dimension is known as a range.

Dimension Unit.description: This field is used to record the unit for the documented instance of dimension.

Dimension Type.description: This field is used to record the formal type of the documented dimension.

Dimension Source Reference.description: This field is used to link the documented dimension to a statement that describes it.
